note: Drawing a box over the map selects the earthquakes inside it and redraws them larger and orange, through setFilter on a second layer over the same source. The fixture draws the page's own starting state, where nothing is selected yet -- the ids come from queryRenderedFeatures, which a fixture cannot ask. The selection itself has no oracle either: the page reaches its ids through `promoteId` and `['id']`, and with the pinned oracle that pair selects nothing, in both renderers alike. Written out as `['get', 'id']` instead, a chosen selection draws the same 1199 pixels on both sides -- so it is the promoted id that neither has, not the filter. What this fixture measures is the base layer: six thousand circles over a world view.
